This could be between the two previous hurdle winners, who are both trained by Gordon Elliott.

The step up in trip looks set to be a good move for the Paul Nicholls-trained A KING OF MAGIC and he can make a winning handicap debut. Joeybottles impressed at Bangor last month and is feared most ahead of Bel Ombre, who is also 1-1 in handicaps.[Ben Hutton] Page 2 spotlightperth 23.04.26

The novice TIMEFORTOM has had a break since being pulled up at Newcastle and could be on a good mark for this handicap debut in view of his previous promise. Heard That has run well on both previous visits to Perth and may be the chief danger ahead of Letterston Lily, who returns from a long absence but is on a competitive mark. Soldier's Leap could be involved if the step up in trip isn't an issue.[Ben Hutton] Page 3 spotlightperth 23.04.26

Having continued in good form since winning at Windsor on New Year's Day, TOOTHLESS can get back on the scoresheet this afternoon. Slanagaibhgoleir has run some solid races during this first chasing campaign and is feared most back down in trip, ahead of the veteran Tommy's Oscar who drops back down in grade.[Ben Hutton] Page 4 spotlightperth 23.04.26
American Mike has dropped to a good mark and is well worth considering, but last year's runner-up STATUARIO is taken to win his seventh race here.[Colin Russell] Page 5 spotlightperth 23.04.26

tricky race, featuring plenty of unexposed sorts, can go to the progressive FOURONEOHFEVER, who was useful on the Flat and got off the mark over hurdles in a Ludlow handicap last time. He is 9lb higher here and is just preferred to the unexposed Fakenham winner Mister Ursus and the 9yo A Different Kind, who was a good second at Doncaster last time.[Colin Russell] Page 6 spotlightperth 23.04.26

This isn't as competitive as the field size suggests and SHADOWFAX OF ROHAN (nap) can make a winning return to hurdles off the same mark as for last month's chase win at Southwell. Recent Market Rasen runner-up Bunker Bay is second choice ahead of Beat The Retreat, who has won two of his last three.[Ben Hutton] Page 8 spotlightperth 23.04.26
